svg.title: Actual JSON PNG learning curve and independent validation detections
svg.desc: Synthetic non-square images are letterboxed to 64 pixels. Green dashed boxes are annotations. Orange boxes and labels are actual decoded model predictions.

g.text: JSON + PNG: learn, detect, save, reload
Fixed CPU run | 3 synthetic classes | 24 train / 12 validation / 12 test | seed 7
1600 Adam steps, batch 8, lr 0.01 | score >= 0.10, NMS 0.50, AP at IoU 0.50
Validation AP50 0.3888888888888889; test AP50 0.6666666666666666; raw reload exact: True
Actual minibatch total loss before each optimizer update
Validation images (unseen during training) | green dashed: GT | orange: prediction + score
Raw model output, optimizer state, and RNG are checked after format-v2 checkpoint reload.
Synthetic exercise only: a short run does not establish real-video accuracy or YOLO-version rankings.
